sn_aia_version.instructions: 1. Read JR by sys_id -> interview_dates_and_timings, interview_time_per_person, panel_members, role_title, responsibilities, interview_type, location_or_link. JR missing, panel_members empty, no usable dates/daily times, or unreadable duration -> stop, create nothing, report reason. 2. Read latest APPROVED/PUBLISHED JD for the JR (jd_text). 3. Query applications: requisition = JR, stage = SHORTLISTED, withdrawn = false, oldest first -> queue. Empty -> stop and report. 4. Get existing Interviews for the JR. Skip applications with a non-cancelled Interview (Already Scheduled). Seed per-panelist interview counts. 5. Read dates, daily hours, lunch (default 1-2 PM IST) and breaks from the schedule text. Build back-to-back slots per date, length = interview_time_per_person, avoiding lunch/breaks (overlap under 5 min allowed). 6. For each candidate in the queue: pick the panelist with the fewest interviews (tie: panel_members order) and the earliest slot. Call Check Panelist Conflict. Busy -> next slot, then next panelist. Nothing free -> Unassigned with reason. 7. For assigned candidates only: get screening result; write 5/7/10 Markdown questions (question, expected answer, rubric), max 4000 chars. 8. Create Interview record. No sys_id returned -> Unassigned with error. 9. Repeat 6-8 until the queue is empty. 10. Write one INTERVIEW_SCHEDULE entry via Log Panel Assignment Run. 11. Report Scheduled, Already Scheduled, Unassigned (reason each), Total. Sum must equal Total.
